verdict.rationale: The only AI reference is a generic boilerplate line saying the firm combines legal expertise with 'legal tech, digital workflows and AI-based systems'. That is exactly the bare marketing mention the story excludes. YSolutions is described as software-supported transparency-register filing, not an AI tool or AI-use disclosure. missing for 10: named AI tools used in client service, a published AI-use or governance policy, and an AI-practice product of the firm's own.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the firm publishes how it uses AI in client service — named tools, policies, or AI-practice products of its own — beyond a marketing mention
